svg.aria-label: Spec sheet. DELIVERY: Figma → production. Marketing site through the full product, owned end to end. ARCHITECTURE: Full-stack platforms. Interface, API and data model designed as one system. INTEGRATION: APIs & services. Designed, documented and debugged until they hold. QUALITY: Tested releases. Unit, integration and end-to-end coverage before anything ships. PERFORMANCE: Fast, then faster. Profiling, debugging and tuning the slow paths. NEXT: Application security. Taking the builder's view of systems into breaking them safely.
